csv_scope_of_work: Profit or non-profit development partners for the redevelopment of parcels at Hillsborough Street and Western Boulevard as a transit-oriented, multifamily, all-affordable or mixed-income rental housing development. The redevelopment site consists of a cluster of City-owned sites located at 0 Western Blvd., 5508 Western Blvd., 5507 Hillsborough Street, and 5511 Hillsborough Street totaling approximately 3.5 acres (the Hillsborough-Western Site or the Site ), and will be made available via long-term land lease. These City-owned parcels present a unique opportunity for the City to create affordable housing along the planned Western Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) corridor.

title: Developer for Hillsborough-Western Redevelopment
short_description: Developer sought for affordable transit-oriented multifamily housing redevelopment on a 3.5-acre city-owned site.
project_scope: Redevelopment of a cluster of City-owned parcels at 0 Western Blvd., 5508 Western Blvd., 5507 Hillsborough Street, and 5511 Hillsborough Street in Raleigh, totaling approximately 3.5 acres. The project is intended as a transit-oriented multifamily rental housing development along the planned Western Boulevard Bus Rapid Transit corridor, to be delivered as all-affordable or mixed-income housing under a long-term land lease.
services: Developer/design-build partner services for redevelopment planning, design, and delivery of a transit-oriented multifamily housing project.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a developer/design-build solicitation rather than a structural engineering design tender.
- Project type is multifamily housing, with no indication of complex long-span, bridge, roof, or special structural systems.
- Could involve building design input, but the notice provides no technical scope for structural engineering.
- Transit-oriented affordable housing is strategically interesting only at a general urban development level, not strongly aligned with sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. Available scope information for a rough estimate: 3.5-acre redevelopment site, multifamily rental housing, all-affordable or mixed-income, transit-oriented development on city-owned land in Raleigh. No unit count, gross floor area, height, parking, or phasing information is provided, so a realistic cost estimate is not possible from the notice alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. The notice is for a developer/design-build partner and does not define a structural engineering fee scope, building size, or construction budget, so an sbp fee estimate is not realistically possible.
references_qualifications: Profit or non-profit development partners are sought; discipline requested is Design Build/Developer. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source excerpt.
